description:
## Context
After filing pages under a project, the Resources tab should show what that project already holds, so the tab is also where you look them up. Once Resources filed under a project are shared (ADR-0082, server ticket `perky.nova`), this list also shows pages other members filed.

Part of the Resources tab work (label `resources-tab`). There is no Linear issue and no plan file: this bead is the spec. Background and decisions:
- This repo: `docs/adr/0001-a-page-reaches-the-server-only-when-saved.md`.
- Server repo `/Users/james/code/exponential/exponential-app`: ADR-0082 (`docs/adr/0082-resource-filed-under-a-project-is-shared-with-it.md`) and the Resource, Reading list and Page text entries in `CONTEXT.md`. Until merged they are on the branch `docs/resources-shared-with-project` (worktree `.claude/worktrees/resources-shared-with-project`).
- Server work is tracked in Exponential under the feature "Resources shared with a project" (`cmwhvax9c0001ld08xnery7bc`); tickets are named below by shortId. Read one with `HOME=/Users/james/.config/agent-homes/claude exponential tickets get <shortId>`.

Repo rules that apply to every bead: source lives in `shared/` (copied into both extensions by `build.sh`); the Resources tab only exists when `EXTENSION_CONFIG.hasSavePage` is true; the glossary bans the label "Read later", so the control is called "Add to Reading list"; finish with `./build.sh --prod` exiting 0 and tell James to reload the extension in `chrome://extensions`.

## Task
1. In `shared/sidepanel.html`, inside `#panelSavePage` above `#recentSavePage`, add a block `#projectResources` (hidden by default) with a header "In this project" and a list `#projectResourcesList`. Reuse the `.recent-items`, `.recent-items-header` and `.recent-items-list` styles.
2. In `shared/sidepanel.js` add `async function loadProjectResources()`:
   - `const projectId = await getSelectedProjectId()` (~193). If empty or `'default'`, hide `#projectResources` and return.
   - `const json = await trpcCall('resource.list', { projectId, limit: 20 }, 'GET')` (~2415); rows are at `extractTrpcData(json).resources` (~2440). Each row has `id`, `title`, `url`, `createdAt`, `project`.
   - Render one row per Resource: title, the host of `url`, and the saved date. Clicking a row opens `url` with `chrome.tabs.create({ url })`. Rows with no `url` are not clickable.
   - If a row carries an owner name that is not the current user (present only after `perky.nova`), append "saved by <name>". Read the field name from the list select in the server's `resource.ts` at that point; do not guess a name before then, simply omit it.
   - Empty result: show "No pages filed under this project yet."
   - On error: hide the block and log with `console.warn`; never block saving.
3. Call `loadProjectResources()` when the Resources tab becomes visible, on the `change` event of `#sharedProject` (~884), and after every successful `saveTabAsResource`.
4. Leave `#recentSavePage` as it is.

## Files
- `shared/sidepanel.html` — modify: `#projectResources` block
- `shared/sidepanel.js` — modify: `loadProjectResources` and its three call sites
- `/Users/james/code/exponential/exponential-app/src/server/api/routers/resource.ts` — read: `list` input (~423) and `resourceListSelect` (~143)

## Dependencies
- Depends on: alpha-chrome-plugin-n4o (Resources tab replaces Save Page: one Save that files a Resource under the selected project)
- Server: None for your own Resources: `resource.list` already filters by `projectId`. Other members' rows appear once `perky.nova` ships.
- Produces: Nothing consumed by other beads.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. With a project selected, the tab lists up to 20 Resources filed under it, newest first, each with title, host and date
2. Clicking a row opens that Resource's address in a new tab
3. Changing the project in the picker replaces the list; choosing no project hides it
4. Saving the current page adds it to the top of the list without reloading the panel
5. A project with no Resources shows "No pages filed under this project yet."
6. A failed request hides the block and does not disable Save
7. `./build.sh --prod` exits 0
close_reason: 'In this project' list from resource.list (20 newest): title, host, date, 'saved by <owner.name>' when isMine is false; click opens http(s) addresses in a new tab; hidden on error or with no project. title: Save all tabs in the current tab group under one project
description:
## Context
The Lanzarote case: three listing tabs in one Chrome tab group, to be filed under one project in one go. Decision: the first version saves every tab of the current group as a Resource and leaves the tabs open; closing and reopening groups is deferred. It reuses `saveTabAsResource` from the Resources tab bead, so each tab is saved exactly as a single page would be.

Part of the Resources tab work (label `resources-tab`). There is no Linear issue and no plan file: this bead is the spec. Background and decisions:
- This repo: `docs/adr/0001-a-page-reaches-the-server-only-when-saved.md`.
- Server repo `/Users/james/code/exponential/exponential-app`: ADR-0082 (`docs/adr/0082-resource-filed-under-a-project-is-shared-with-it.md`) and the Resource, Reading list and Page text entries in `CONTEXT.md`. Until merged they are on the branch `docs/resources-shared-with-project` (worktree `.claude/worktrees/resources-shared-with-project`).
- Server work is tracked in Exponential under the feature "Resources shared with a project" (`cmwhvax9c0001ld08xnery7bc`); tickets are named below by shortId. Read one with `HOME=/Users/james/.config/agent-homes/claude exponential tickets get <shortId>`.

Repo rules that apply to every bead: source lives in `shared/` (copied into both extensions by `build.sh`); the Resources tab only exists when `EXTENSION_CONFIG.hasSavePage` is true; the glossary bans the label "Read later", so the control is called "Add to Reading list"; finish with `./build.sh --prod` exiting 0 and tell James to reload the extension in `chrome://extensions`.

## Task
1. In `exponential/manifest.json` add `"tabGroups"` to `permissions`. Do not add it to `tradescape/manifest.json`; guard every use with `if (chrome.tabGroups)`.
2. In `shared/sidepanel.html`, inside `#panelSavePage` under the Save controls, add a button `#resourceSaveGroupBtn` (hidden by default) and a container `#resourceGroupPanel` (hidden by default) for the checklist.
3. In `shared/sidepanel.js` add `async function refreshGroupSaveButton()`: get the active tab with `getActiveNormalTab()` (~2024); if `chrome.tabGroups` exists and `tab.groupId` is not `chrome.tabGroups.TAB_GROUP_ID_NONE`, load the group with `chrome.tabGroups.get(tab.groupId)` and its tabs with `chrome.tabs.query({ groupId: tab.groupId, windowId: tab.windowId })`, then show the button as `Save N tabs in "<group title>"` (use "this group" when the title is empty). Otherwise hide it. Call it on panel load, on `chrome.tabs.onActivated`, on `chrome.tabs.onUpdated` when `changeInfo.groupId !== undefined`, and on `chrome.tabGroups.onUpdated`.
4. Clicking the button opens the checklist in `#resourceGroupPanel`: one row per tab with a checkbox, the tab title and its host. A tab is unchecked and disabled, with a reason, when its URL is not http(s) ("Can't be saved") or `tab.incognito` is true. All others start checked.
5. A project is required for a group save: if `getSelectedProjectId()` (~193) returns nothing or `'default'`, show "Choose a project first" and disable Confirm. The Confirm button reads `Save N pages to <project name>`; a Cancel button closes the panel.
6. On Confirm, save the checked tabs one at a time, in tab order, by calling `saveTabAsResource(tab, { queue, index })` with the current state of `#resourceQueueToggle` and `#resourceIndexToggle`. Show progress "Saving 2 of 5..." and write each row's outcome beside it: "Saved", "Already saved, updated", or "Failed: <message>". One failure does not stop the rest.
7. A discarded tab (`tab.discarded === true`) is saved as a bare link, title and URL only: do not inject into it and do not reload it. Add an option to `saveTabAsResource` (`{ skipExtract: true }`) for this.
8. Never close, move, reload or activate any tab.
9. When finished, show a summary "Saved 4, already saved 1, failed 0" in `#savePageStatus` and leave the checklist visible until the user closes it.

## Files
- `exponential/manifest.json` — modify: add `tabGroups`
- `shared/sidepanel.html` — modify: button, checklist container, styles
- `shared/sidepanel.js` — modify: `refreshGroupSaveButton`, checklist, sequential save, `skipExtract` option on `saveTabAsResource`

## Dependencies
- Depends on: alpha-chrome-plugin-n4o (Resources tab replaces Save Page: one Save that files a Resource under the selected project)
- Server: None. Improves automatically as `witty.otter` (identity) and `damp.gem` (Page text) land, because it calls the same save function.
- Produces: A group-save completion point (group title, project id, workspace id) that the tab-group suggestion bead hooks into.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. With the active tab in a group of three web pages, the button reads `Save 3 tabs in "<title>"`; with the active tab in no group, the button is hidden
2. The checklist lists every tab of the group; a `chrome://` tab in the group is unchecked, disabled and labelled
3. With no project selected, Confirm is disabled and "Choose a project first" is shown
4. Confirming saves each checked tab as a Resource under the selected project, and all three appear under that project in Exponential
5. Unticking a tab leaves it unsaved
6. A discarded tab is saved as a bare link and is still discarded afterwards
7. Every tab is still open, in the same order and group, after the save
8. A server error on one tab is shown on its row and the remaining tabs are still saved
9. In `dist/tradescape-prod`, the panel loads with no console error about `chrome.tabGroups`
10. `./build.sh --prod` exits 0
close_reason: tabGroups permission added to the Exponential Capture manifest and not to Tradescape; 'Save N tabs in "title"' button, checklist, sequential save with per-row outcome and summary, skipExtract for discarded tabs, project fixed at Confirm. Tradescape harness without chrome.tabGroups loads clean. Verified in a browser harness (the built panel with stubbed chrome.* APIs and a fake tRPC server) and by reading the shipped server code; not yet exercised in real Chrome against production.

title: Save sends the page's declared URL and its cleaned visited address
description:
## Context
A Resource is matched by identity and opens at the address it was last saved from (see the Resource entry in the server's `CONTEXT.md`). The server computes identity from two things the extension must now send: the URL the page declares for itself, and the visited URL. Today the save sends only `tab.url`, tracking parameters included, so the same listing with different dates becomes two Resources.

Part of the Resources tab work (label `resources-tab`). There is no Linear issue and no plan file: this bead is the spec. Background and decisions:
- This repo: `docs/adr/0001-a-page-reaches-the-server-only-when-saved.md`.
- Server repo `/Users/james/code/exponential/exponential-app`: ADR-0082 (`docs/adr/0082-resource-filed-under-a-project-is-shared-with-it.md`) and the Resource, Reading list and Page text entries in `CONTEXT.md`. Until merged they are on the branch `docs/resources-shared-with-project` (worktree `.claude/worktrees/resources-shared-with-project`).
- Server work is tracked in Exponential under the feature "Resources shared with a project" (`cmwhvax9c0001ld08xnery7bc`); tickets are named below by shortId. Read one with `HOME=/Users/james/.config/agent-homes/claude exponential tickets get <shortId>`.

Repo rules that apply to every bead: source lives in `shared/` (copied into both extensions by `build.sh`); the Resources tab only exists when `EXTENSION_CONFIG.hasSavePage` is true; the glossary bans the label "Read later", so the control is called "Add to Reading list"; finish with `./build.sh --prod` exiting 0 and tell James to reload the extension in `chrome://extensions`.

## Task
1. In `shared/readability-extract.js`, add `declaredUrl` to the object returned by `globalThis.__expoExtractArticle`: `document.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]')?.href || meta('meta[property="og:url"]') || undefined`. `meta` is the helper already defined at the top of that function. Rebuild is handled by `build.sh` (esbuild step at line ~27).
2. In `saveTabAsResource` in `shared/sidepanel.js` (added by the Resources tab bead):
   - Send `url: ExpoPageIdentity.savedAddress(tab.url)` instead of `tab.url`.
   - Send the declared URL when `extractArticle` returned one. The expected input name is `declaredUrl`; confirm it against the `create` input in `/Users/james/code/exponential/exponential-app/src/server/api/routers/resource.ts` once ticket `witty.otter` has merged, and use whatever name it shipped.
   - When `extractArticle` returns `null` (page can't be scripted) or the tab was saved with `skipExtract`, send no declared URL.
3. Do not compute or send an identity from the extension: the server owns it. The extension's own `pageIdentity` is only for matching in the browser.

## Files
- `shared/readability-extract.js` — modify: return `declaredUrl`
- `shared/sidepanel.js` — modify: `saveTabAsResource` request input
- `/Users/james/code/exponential/exponential-app/src/server/api/routers/resource.ts` — read: `create` input name for the declared URL

## Dependencies
- Depends on: alpha-chrome-plugin-n4o (Resources tab replaces Save Page: one Save that files a Resource under the selected project)
- Depends on: alpha-chrome-plugin-zfh (Page identity function with tests (declared-URL guard, tracking stripped))
- Server: Blocked by ticket `witty.otter` being merged and deployed. Sending an input field the server does not know yet would fail validation, so do not start this bead before then.
- Produces: Saves that the server can match by identity; nothing consumed by other beads.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Saving an Airbnb listing sends a `url` that keeps `adults`, `check_in` and `check_out` and drops `source_impression_id`; parameters that are not on the tracking denylist, such as `federated_search_id`, are kept
2. The request carries the listing's declared URL (`https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/<id>`)
3. Saving the same listing again with different dates updates the one Resource, and its link in Exponential opens the second visit's dates
4. A page with no canonical link and no `og:url` saves normally with no declared URL in the request
5. A discarded tab saved from group save sends no declared URL and still saves
6. `./build.sh --prod` exits 0
close_reason: Save sends url = savedAddress(tab.url) and declaredUrl (canonical link, else og:url) from the extractor; none for a page that can't be scripted or a skipExtract save. Field name declaredUrl confirmed in resource.ts. Verified in a browser harness (the built panel with stubbed chrome.* APIs and a fake tRPC server) and by reading the shipped server code; not yet exercised in real Chrome against production.

description:
## Context The Resources tab should say whether the page in front of you is already saved and where. The side panel stays open across tabs, so asking the server about each page would send it your browsing. Decision (ADR 0001 in this repo): download the identities of the Resources you can see once, and match in the browser. Nothing about a page leaves the browser until Save is pressed. Part of the Resources tab work (label `resources-tab`). There is no Linear issue and no plan file: this bead is the spec. Background and decisions: - This repo: `docs/adr/0001-a-page-reaches-the-server-only-when-saved.md`. - Server repo `/Users/james/code/exponential/exponential-app`: ADR-0082 (`docs/adr/0082-resource-filed-under-a-project-is-shared-with-it.md`) and the Resource, Reading list and Page text entries in `CONTEXT.md`. Until merged they are on the branch `docs/resources-shared-with-project` (worktree `.claude/worktrees/resources-shared-with-project`). - Server work is tracked in Exponential under the feature "Resources shared with a project" (`cmwhvax9c0001ld08xnery7bc`); tickets are named below by shortId. Read one with `HOME=/Users/james/.config/agent-homes/claude exponential tickets get `. Repo rules that apply to every bead: source lives in `shared/` (copied into both extensions by `build.sh`); the Resources tab only exists when `EXTENSION_CONFIG.hasSavePage` is true; the glossary bans the label "Read later", so the control is called "Add to Reading list"; finish with `./build.sh --prod` exiting 0 and tell James to reload the extension in `chrome://extensions`. ## Task 1. In `shared/sidepanel.js` add an in-memory index: `let resourceIdentityIndex = new Map()` from identity string to an array of entries `{ id, title, projectId, projectName, workspaceId, ownerName, isMine, readStatus }`. Do not persist it to `chrome.storage`. 2. Add `async function refreshResourceIdentities()` that loads the list with `trpcCall(, undefined, 'GET')` (`trpcCall` ~2415) and rebuilds the map. The procedure is the one added by server ticket `sly.breeze` ("The caller can fetch the identities of the Resources they can see"); read its name, response shape and any cursor from `/Users/james/code/exponential/exponential-app/src/server/api/routers/resource.ts` once that ticket has merged, and follow the cursor until the list is complete. Call it when the panel finishes authenticating (where `populateSharedDropdowns` ~508 is called) and after every successful `saveTabAsResource`. 3. In `shared/sidepanel.html` add `
` as the first child of `#panelSavePage`. 4. Add `async function updateResourceStatus()`: - Only runs while the Resources tab is the visible panel. - Active tab from `getActiveNormalTab()` (~2024). If its URL is not http(s): show "This page can't be saved". - Read the page's declared URL inside the tab with a small inline function, not the Readability bundle: `chrome.scripting.executeScript({ target: { tabId }, func: () => document.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]')?.href || document.querySelector('meta[property="og:url"]')?.content || null })`. If injection throws, use `null`. - `const identity = ExpoPageIdentity.pageIdentity(tab.url, declaredUrl)`; look it up in the map. - No entry: "Not saved yet". An entry with `isMine`: "Saved in " or "Saved (no project)", plus " · on your Reading list" when `readStatus` is `to_read` or `reading`. Entries that are not mine are rendered by a later bead; for now ignore them. - Guard against races: keep a sequence counter and drop a result if a newer call started. 5. Call `updateResourceStatus()` on: switching to the Resources tab, `chrome.tabs.onActivated`, `chrome.tabs.onUpdated` for the active tab when `changeInfo.url` or `changeInfo.status === 'complete'`, `chrome.windows.onFocusChanged`, and after `refreshResourceIdentities()` resolves. 6. Hard rule from ADR 0001: no request made by this bead may contain the current tab's URL, title, identity or content. The only network call is the parameterless list fetch. ## Files - `shared/sidepanel.js` — modify: identity index, `refreshResourceIdentities`, `updateResourceStatus`, tab and window listeners - `shared/sidepanel.html` — modify: `#resourceStatus` element and style - `docs/adr/0001-a-page-reaches-the-server-only-when-saved.md` — read: the rule - `/Users/james/code/exponential/exponential-app/src/server/api/routers/resource.ts` — read: the identities procedure ## Dependencies - Depends on: alpha-chrome-plugin-n4o (Resources tab replaces Save Page: one Save that files a Resource under the selected project) - Depends on: alpha-chrome-plugin-zfh (Page identity function with tests (declared-URL guard, tracking stripped)) - Server: Blocked by ticket `sly.breeze` being merged and deployed (itself blocked by `witty.otter`). - Produces: `resourceIdentityIndex`, `refreshResourceIdentities()` and `updateResourceStatus()` for the move and visibility bead. ## Acceptance Criteria 1. On a page saved earlier under Travel, the tab shows "Saved in Travel" within a second of switching to it 2. On the same listing opened with different dates and tracking parameters, the status still shows "Saved in Travel" 3. On an unsaved page it shows "Not saved yet", and immediately after pressing Save it changes to the saved status without reloading the panel 4. On `chrome://extensions` it shows "This page can't be saved" and no error is logged 5. With the side panel's DevTools Network tab open, switching between ten tabs produces zero requests 6. The only request this feature makes has no query input and no body 7. Switching quickly between two tabs never leaves the first tab's status showing on the second 8. `./build.sh --prod` exits 0
close_reason: resourceIdentityIndex + refreshResourceIdentities (resource.identities, cursor followed) + updateResourceStatus with a sequence guard. Ten tab switches made zero requests in the harness; the only request has no input on its first page. Shows nothing, not 'Not saved yet', until the list has loaded. Verified in a browser harness (the built panel with stubbed chrome.* APIs and a fake tRPC server) and by reading the shipped server code; not yet exercised in real Chrome against production.

description:
## Context After a group save the extension knows which project a tab group went into. Decision: remember that link in the browser, keyed by the group's title because Chrome's group ids do not survive a restart, and when you are in a linked group SUGGEST its project. The panel must never switch project on its own: the workspace and project selector is shared by Create Action, Add Contact and Track Time, and a silent switch would misfile work. Part of the Resources tab work (label `resources-tab`). There is no Linear issue and no plan file: this bead is the spec. Background and decisions: - This repo: `docs/adr/0001-a-page-reaches-the-server-only-when-saved.md`. - Server repo `/Users/james/code/exponential/exponential-app`: ADR-0082 (`docs/adr/0082-resource-filed-under-a-project-is-shared-with-it.md`) and the Resource, Reading list and Page text entries in `CONTEXT.md`. Until merged they are on the branch `docs/resources-shared-with-project` (worktree `.claude/worktrees/resources-shared-with-project`). - Server work is tracked in Exponential under the feature "Resources shared with a project" (`cmwhvax9c0001ld08xnery7bc`); tickets are named below by shortId. Read one with `HOME=/Users/james/.config/agent-homes/claude exponential tickets get `. Repo rules that apply to every bead: source lives in `shared/` (copied into both extensions by `build.sh`); the Resources tab only exists when `EXTENSION_CONFIG.hasSavePage` is true; the glossary bans the label "Read later", so the control is called "Add to Reading list"; finish with `./build.sh --prod` exiting 0 and tell James to reload the extension in `chrome://extensions`. ## Task 1. Storage. Keep links in `chrome.storage.local` under `TAB_GROUP_PROJECT_LINKS`: an object keyed by the group title trimmed and lowercased, with values `{ projectId, projectName, workspaceId, title }`. Groups with an empty title are never linked. 2. Write the link at the end of a successful group save (at least one tab saved) in the group-save flow in `shared/sidepanel.js`, using the group title from `chrome.tabGroups.get`, the selected project id and name, and the value of `#sharedWorkspace`. Saving the same group into a different project later overwrites the link. 3. Suggestion chip. In `shared/sidepanel.html` add `
` between `#sharedProjectSelector` (~1528) and `#panelTabs` (~1544), so it is visible on every tab. Add `async function updateGroupLinkChip()`: - If `chrome.tabGroups` is missing, or the active tab is in no group, or the group has no link, or the linked project is already the selected one, or the chip was dismissed for this group id in this panel session: hide it. - Otherwise show: `This group is linked to .` with a "Switch" button and a dismiss "×". 4. Switch sets the workspace and project through the existing path, never by writing storage directly: set `sharedWorkspace.value = workspaceId`, `await loadSharedGoalsAndProjects(workspaceId, { projectId })` (~483), persist `SELECTED_WORKSPACE_ID`, then dispatch `change` on `#sharedProject` so the existing handler (~884) persists the project. If the project no longer exists in the loaded list, show "That project is no longer available", delete the link and hide the chip. 5. Dismiss hides the chip for that group id until the panel is reloaded (keep a `Set` in memory). 6. Call `updateGroupLinkChip()` on panel load, `chrome.tabs.onActivated`, `chrome.tabs.onUpdated` when `changeInfo.groupId !== undefined`, `chrome.tabGroups.onUpdated`, and on `change` of `#sharedProject`. 7. Never change the selected project without a click on Switch. A running time entry is unaffected because switching only changes the selectors. 8. New-project prefill: when the user picks "New project…" while the active tab is in a titled group, call `openNewProjectRow(groupTitle)` (from the new-project bead) so the name is prefilled. ## Files - `shared/sidepanel.html` — modify: `#groupLinkChip` element and style - `shared/sidepanel.js` — modify: link storage, `updateGroupLinkChip`, hook at the end of group save, new-project prefill ## Dependencies - Depends on: alpha-chrome-plugin-7em (Save all tabs in the current tab group under one project) - Depends on: alpha-chrome-plugin-vgz (Project picker offers "New project…") - Server: None. - Produces: Nothing consumed by other beads. ## Acceptance Criteria 1. After saving the group "Lanzarote" into the Lanzarote project, `TAB_GROUP_PROJECT_LINKS` has an entry under `lanzarote` 2. With another project selected, switching to a tab in that group shows "This group is linked to Lanzarote." and the selected project does not change 3. Clicking Switch selects the Lanzarote workspace and project, and the chip disappears 4. Dismissing the chip hides it for that group until the panel is reloaded 5. Switching to a tab outside any group hides the chip and leaves the selected project unchanged 6. After restarting Chrome, a group with the same title still triggers the suggestion 7. If the linked project has been deleted, Switch reports it, removes the link and hides the chip 8. Choosing "New project…" inside a titled group prefills the name with the group title 9. `./build.sh --prod` exits 0

description:
## Context Filing a Resource under a project shares it with that project's members (ADR-0082). Three rules follow for the Resources tab: moving a saved page to another project is always an explicit act; a project lists a page once, so a page a teammate already filed there cannot be filed again; and before saving, the tab says who will be able to see the page. Part of the Resources tab work (label `resources-tab`). There is no Linear issue and no plan file: this bead is the spec. Background and decisions: - This repo: `docs/adr/0001-a-page-reaches-the-server-only-when-saved.md`. - Server repo `/Users/james/code/exponential/exponential-app`: ADR-0082 (`docs/adr/0082-resource-filed-under-a-project-is-shared-with-it.md`) and the Resource, Reading list and Page text entries in `CONTEXT.md`. Until merged they are on the branch `docs/resources-shared-with-project` (worktree `.claude/worktrees/resources-shared-with-project`). - Server work is tracked in Exponential under the feature "Resources shared with a project" (`cmwhvax9c0001ld08xnery7bc`); tickets are named below by shortId. Read one with `HOME=/Users/james/.config/agent-homes/claude exponential tickets get `. Repo rules that apply to every bead: source lives in `shared/` (copied into both extensions by `build.sh`); the Resources tab only exists when `EXTENSION_CONFIG.hasSavePage` is true; the glossary bans the label "Read later", so the control is called "Add to Reading list"; finish with `./build.sh --prod` exiting 0 and tell James to reload the extension in `chrome://extensions`. ## Task All changes are in the Resources tab (`#panelSavePage`), building on the status line and identity index from the status-line bead. 1. Who-can-see-it line. Add `
` directly above `#resourceSaveBtn` in `shared/sidepanel.html`. In `shared/sidepanel.js` set it whenever the project selection changes and on panel load: "Visible to everyone who can see " when a project is selected, "Only you can see this" when none. 2. Saving an already-saved page never moves it. In `saveTabAsResource`, when the identity index has an entry with `isMine` for the page, send that entry's `projectId` (or none) instead of the selected project. 3. Explicit move. In `updateResourceStatus`, when the page is mine, is filed under project A (or none), and the selected project B is different and non-empty, show a secondary button in the status line: "Move to ". It calls `trpcCall('resource.update', { id, projectId: B })` (`trpcCall` ~2415; server procedure `update` in `resource.ts` ~508). On success call `refreshResourceIdentities()` and show "Moved to ". The who-can-see-it line already tells the user who will see it after the move. 4. Saved by someone else. When the index has an entry for the page that is not mine (available once `perky.nova` ships), the status line shows "In , saved by ". If the selected project is that same project: - With "Add to Reading list" unticked, disable Save and show "Already in this project". - With it ticked, Save stays enabled and saves the caller's own Resource with NO `projectId` and `readStatus: 'to_read'`; the status then shows both facts: "In , saved by · on your Reading list". 5. Stale list. The index can be out of date, so a save into a project may be refused by the server because the page is already there (ticket `keen.quill`). Read how that refusal is reported from the server's `resource.ts` once the ticket has merged, show "Already in this project, saved by ", and call `refreshResourceIdentities()`. Treat a refused move the same way. 6. Group save: a tab whose page is already in the target project, whoever saved it, is listed as "Already in this project" and skipped, not re-saved. ## Files - `shared/sidepanel.html` — modify: `#resourceVisibility` element and style, move button style - `shared/sidepanel.js` — modify: `saveTabAsResource`, `updateResourceStatus`, group-save row outcome - `/Users/james/code/exponential/exponential-app/src/server/api/routers/resource.ts` — read: `update` input, and the already-in-project response from `keen.quill` ## Dependencies - Depends on: alpha-chrome-plugin-idr ("Already saved?" status line, matched in the browser) - Depends on: alpha-chrome-plugin-7em (Save all tabs in the current tab group under one project) - Server: Steps 1 to 3 need only the status-line bead. Steps 4 to 6 are blocked by tickets `perky.nova` (project members can see Resources) and `keen.quill` (a page is filed once per project) being merged and deployed; if they have not shipped, implement steps 1 to 3 and leave this bead open. - Produces: Nothing consumed by other beads. ## Acceptance Criteria 1. With a project selected the line above Save reads "Visible to everyone who can see "; with none it reads "Only you can see this" 2. Pressing Save on a page already filed under Travel while Lanzarote is selected leaves it under Travel 3. "Move to Lanzarote" appears in that situation, and pressing it moves the Resource and updates the status to "Saved in Lanzarote" 4. On a page a teammate filed under the selected project, the status reads "In , saved by " and Save is disabled 5. Ticking "Add to Reading list" there enables Save, and saving creates the caller's own queued Resource with no project 6. When the server refuses a save because the page is already in the project, the tab shows who saved it and refreshes its list 7. In a group save, a tab already in the target project is reported as "Already in this project" and no request is sent for it 8. `./build.sh --prod` exits 0
close_reason: All six steps: who-can-see-it line; a re-save keeps the Resource's own project and workspace; explicit 'Move to <project>' via resource.update; 'In <project>, saved by <name>' with Save held unless the Reading list is ticked (then saved with no projectId); CONFLICT error.data.alreadyInProject handled for save and move; group save skips pages the target project already lists without a request. Verified in a browser harness (the built panel with stubbed chrome.* APIs and a fake tRPC server) and by reading the shipped server code; not yet exercised in real Chrome against production.

description:
## Context
Listings, searches and dashboards have no Article body, so today they are saved as bare links that search and Zoe cannot read. Decision: such pages keep their visible text as **Page text** (new entry in the server's `CONTEXT.md`), stored apart from the Article body and never shown in the reader. In the Lanzarote trial the plain visible text of an Airbnb listing contained the price, rating, cancellation terms and reviews.

Part of the Resources tab work (label `resources-tab`). There is no Linear issue and no plan file: this bead is the spec. Background and decisions:
- This repo: `docs/adr/0001-a-page-reaches-the-server-only-when-saved.md`.
- Server repo `/Users/james/code/exponential/exponential-app`: ADR-0082 (`docs/adr/0082-resource-filed-under-a-project-is-shared-with-it.md`) and the Resource, Reading list and Page text entries in `CONTEXT.md`. Until merged they are on the branch `docs/resources-shared-with-project` (worktree `.claude/worktrees/resources-shared-with-project`).
- Server work is tracked in Exponential under the feature "Resources shared with a project" (`cmwhvax9c0001ld08xnery7bc`); tickets are named below by shortId. Read one with `HOME=/Users/james/.config/agent-homes/claude exponential tickets get <shortId>`.

Repo rules that apply to every bead: source lives in `shared/` (copied into both extensions by `build.sh`); the Resources tab only exists when `EXTENSION_CONFIG.hasSavePage` is true; the glossary bans the label "Read later", so the control is called "Add to Reading list"; finish with `./build.sh --prod` exiting 0 and tell James to reload the extension in `chrome://extensions`.

## Task
1. In `shared/readability-extract.js`, extend `globalThis.__expoExtractArticle` to also return `pageText` when the page is not an article, i.e. when `isProbablyReaderable(document)` is false or Readability produced no `content`:
   - Start from `document.body.innerText`.
   - Split into lines, trim each, drop empty lines.
   - Drop a line that is identical to the line before it, and drop any line once it has already appeared three times (this removes repeated banners such as Airbnb's "Rare find!" and calendar grids).
   - Join with newlines and cut to 100,000 characters.
   - Return `undefined` when the result is shorter than 200 characters.
2. In `saveTabAsResource` in `shared/sidepanel.js`, choose what to send:
   - Article: when `article.readerable` is true and `article.content` exists and fits `MAX_ARTICLE_HTML_CHARS` (~2031), send `rawContent` as today and no Page text.
   - Not an article: when `article.pageText` exists, send it as Page text and send no `rawContent`. The expected input name is `pageText`; confirm it against the `create` input in the server's `resource.ts` once ticket `damp.gem` has merged.
   - Neither: bare link, as today.
   - `contentType` is `'web_page'` when either a body or Page text is sent, `'bookmark'` otherwise.
3. This changes one existing behaviour on purpose: a page Readability can parse but `isProbablyReaderable` rejects used to be saved with its Readability output as the Article body. It is now saved with Page text instead, because for listings that output is fragments. Note this in a comment where the choice is made.
4. Status text: append " (page text saved for search)" when Page text was sent, in place of " (link only, no page text)".
5. Return `hadBody` and a new `hadPageText` from `saveTabAsResource` so group save can report them.

## Files
- `shared/readability-extract.js` — modify: return `pageText`
- `shared/sidepanel.js` — modify: `saveTabAsResource` body-or-text choice and status text
- `/Users/james/code/exponential/exponential-app/src/server/api/routers/resource.ts` — read: `create` input name for Page text

## Dependencies
- Depends on: alpha-chrome-plugin-n4o (Resources tab replaces Save Page: one Save that files a Resource under the selected project)
- Server: Blocked by ticket `damp.gem` ("A Resource can carry Page text") being merged and deployed.
- Produces: Page text on saved non-article Resources; nothing consumed by other beads.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Saving an Airbnb listing sends Page text that contains the total price shown on the page, and sends no `rawContent`
2. Saving a long news or blog article sends `rawContent` and no Page text, as before
3. The Page text of a listing contains a repeated banner line at most three times
4. Page text is never longer than 100,000 characters
5. A page with almost no text is saved as a bare link with `contentType: "bookmark"`
6. With "Add to knowledge" ticked, searching Exponential for a phrase that appears only in the listing's text finds the Resource
7. `./build.sh --prod` exits 0
close_reason: Extractor returns pageText for non-articles (shared/page-text.js, 5 unit tests: dedupe, 3-repeat cap, 100,000 cap, 200 minimum). Save sends rawContent for an article, pageText otherwise, bookmark when neither. Field name pageText confirmed in resource.ts. Verified in a browser harness (the built panel with stubbed chrome.* APIs and a fake tRPC server) and by reading the shipped server code; not yet exercised in real Chrome against production.

title: Project picker offers "New project…"
description:
## Context
A new line of research usually starts in the browser before any project exists (the Lanzarote trip had none). Decision: the project picker can create a project by name. The picker is already searchable: `makeSearchableSelect` (`shared/sidepanel.js` ~696) layers a filter input over the native `#sharedProject` select, so this bead adds only the create row. Because filing under a project shares the page with that project's members (ADR-0082), the create row must say who will see it.

Part of the Resources tab work (label `resources-tab`). There is no Linear issue and no plan file: this bead is the spec. Background and decisions:
- This repo: `docs/adr/0001-a-page-reaches-the-server-only-when-saved.md`.
- Server repo `/Users/james/code/exponential/exponential-app`: ADR-0082 (`docs/adr/0082-resource-filed-under-a-project-is-shared-with-it.md`) and the Resource, Reading list and Page text entries in `CONTEXT.md`. Until merged they are on the branch `docs/resources-shared-with-project` (worktree `.claude/worktrees/resources-shared-with-project`).
- Server work is tracked in Exponential under the feature "Resources shared with a project" (`cmwhvax9c0001ld08xnery7bc`); tickets are named below by shortId. Read one with `HOME=/Users/james/.config/agent-homes/claude exponential tickets get <shortId>`.

Repo rules that apply to every bead: source lives in `shared/` (copied into both extensions by `build.sh`); the Resources tab only exists when `EXTENSION_CONFIG.hasSavePage` is true; the glossary bans the label "Read later", so the control is called "Add to Reading list"; finish with `./build.sh --prod` exiting 0 and tell James to reload the extension in `chrome://extensions`.

## Task
1. In `renderSharedProjects` (`shared/sidepanel.js` ~452), after the project options, append `<option value="__new__" data-searchable-keep>New project…</option>`. `data-searchable-keep` keeps it visible while filtering, as "All goals" does.
2. In the `#sharedProject` change handler (~884): when the value is `__new__`, do not persist it and do not call `stopListening()`. Restore the select to the previously selected project id (track it in a module variable updated on every real change), then open an inline create row.
3. The create row is rendered inside `#sharedProjectSelector` (`shared/sidepanel.html` ~1528), directly under `#sharedProject`: a text input `#newProjectName` (placeholder "Project name"), a checkbox `#newProjectRestricted` labelled "Restricted", a line of help text, and Create / Cancel buttons. Help text: "Visible to everyone in <workspace name>" when unrestricted, "Visible only to you and people you add" when the box is ticked; the workspace name is the selected option text of `#sharedWorkspace`.
4. Create requires a workspace to be selected; if `#sharedWorkspace` has no value, show "Select a workspace first" in the row and do nothing.
5. On Create: `trpcCall('project.create', { name, status: 'ACTIVE', priority: 'NONE', workspaceId, isRestricted })` (`trpcCall` ~2415, POST). The server procedure is `create` in `/Users/james/code/exponential/exponential-app/src/server/api/routers/project.ts` (~269); `name`, `status` and `priority` are required.
6. On success: read the new project from `extractTrpcData(json)` (~2440), push `{ id, name, slug }` onto `sharedProjectsCache` (~435), call `renderSharedProjects(newId)`, then dispatch a `change` event on `#sharedProject` so `SELECTED_PROJECT_ID` is persisted by the existing handler. Close the row.
7. On failure: show the server message (use `readTrpcErrorMessage`-style extraction; `trpcCall` throws `HTTP <status>`, so call `authenticatedFetch` directly here if the message is needed) and keep the row open.
8. Cancel closes the row and leaves the previous selection.
9. Add an exported hook for a later bead: a module-level function `openNewProjectRow(prefillName)` that opens the row with the name prefilled.

## Files
- `shared/sidepanel.js` — modify: `renderSharedProjects`, the `#sharedProject` change handler, new create-row logic, `openNewProjectRow`
- `shared/sidepanel.html` — modify: create-row markup and styles inside `#sharedProjectSelector`
- `/Users/james/code/exponential/exponential-app/src/server/api/routers/project.ts` — read: `create` input

## Dependencies
- Depends on: alpha-chrome-plugin-n4o (Resources tab replaces Save Page: one Save that files a Resource under the selected project)
- Server: None. `project.create` exists today.
- Produces: `openNewProjectRow(prefillName)` for the tab-group suggestion bead.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. The project picker lists "New project…" last, and it stays visible while typing in the filter
2. Choosing it opens the create row and never stores `__new__` in `SELECTED_PROJECT_ID`
3. Creating "Lanzarote" in the Personal workspace selects the new project in the picker, and it exists in Exponential as ACTIVE with priority NONE
4. The help text names the selected workspace and changes when Restricted is ticked; a restricted project is created with `isRestricted: true`
5. With no workspace selected, Create shows "Select a workspace first" and sends nothing
6. Cancel restores the previous project selection
7. Create Action and Track Time still read the selected project correctly after a project is created
8. `./build.sh --prod` exits 0
close_reason: 'New project…' is the picker's last option and survives filtering via a new data-searchable-always attribute (data-searchable-keep does not exempt an option from the text filter, contrary to the bead); create row with Restricted, help text, project.create, openNewProjectRow(prefill). Creating under an active goal filter clears the filter so the new project is listed. Verified in a browser harness (the built panel with stubbed chrome.* APIs and a fake tRPC server) and by reading the shipped server code; not yet exercised in real Chrome against production.

title: Page identity function with tests (declared-URL guard, tracking stripped)
description:
## Context
"Is this page already saved?" is answered in the browser (ADR 0001), so the extension must compute the same page identity the server does. One Resource per page: its identity is the URL the page declares for itself when that passes a guard, else the visited URL without tracking parameters. The server implements the same rule in ticket `witty.otter` ("A Resource has an identity and a last-saved address"); the example table below is shared between the two and must stay identical. This repo has no tests today, so this bead also adds a minimal runner.

Part of the Resources tab work (label `resources-tab`). There is no Linear issue and no plan file: this bead is the spec. Background and decisions:
- This repo: `docs/adr/0001-a-page-reaches-the-server-only-when-saved.md`.
- Server repo `/Users/james/code/exponential/exponential-app`: ADR-0082 (`docs/adr/0082-resource-filed-under-a-project-is-shared-with-it.md`) and the Resource, Reading list and Page text entries in `CONTEXT.md`. Until merged they are on the branch `docs/resources-shared-with-project` (worktree `.claude/worktrees/resources-shared-with-project`).
- Server work is tracked in Exponential under the feature "Resources shared with a project" (`cmwhvax9c0001ld08xnery7bc`); tickets are named below by shortId. Read one with `HOME=/Users/james/.config/agent-homes/claude exponential tickets get <shortId>`.

Repo rules that apply to every bead: source lives in `shared/` (copied into both extensions by `build.sh`); the Resources tab only exists when `EXTENSION_CONFIG.hasSavePage` is true; the glossary bans the label "Read later", so the control is called "Add to Reading list"; finish with `./build.sh --prod` exiting 0 and tell James to reload the extension in `chrome://extensions`.

## Task
1. Create `shared/page-identity.js` as a classic script (no imports, no DOM access) that defines three pure functions and exposes them both ways:
   ```js
   const api = { pageIdentity, savedAddress, isTrackingParam };
   globalThis.ExpoPageIdentity = api;
   if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports = api;
   ```
2. `isTrackingParam(name)`: true for names starting `utm_`, for `fbclid`, `gclid`, `msclkid`, `mc_cid`, `mc_eid`, `igshid`, and for names ending `_impression_id`. Case-insensitive. Everything else is false (unknown parameters are kept: they may be dates or guests).
3. `savedAddress(visitedUrl)`: the visited URL with tracking parameters removed and nothing else changed (parameter order, fragment and case preserved). Returns `null` when the URL is not `http:` or `https:` or does not parse.
4. `pageIdentity(visitedUrl, declaredUrl)`:
   - Returns `null` when `visitedUrl` is not http(s) or does not parse.
   - Use `declaredUrl` only if it parses, is http(s), has the same host as the visited URL ignoring a leading `www.` on either, and has the same path ignoring a trailing slash. Otherwise use `visitedUrl`.
   - Normalise the chosen URL: lowercase scheme and host, drop the fragment, drop a trailing slash on a non-root path, remove tracking parameters, sort the remaining parameters by name (stable for repeated names). Path case is preserved.
5. Create `test/page-identity.test.js` using `node:test` and `node:assert/strict`, requiring `../shared/page-identity.js`. Cover this table exactly, plus the extra cases listed under Acceptance Criteria:

   | Visited | Declared | Identity |
   |---|---|---|
   | `https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/53368445?adults=4&check_in=2027-01-25&check_out=2027-01-30&source_impression_id=p3_x` | `https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/53368445` | `https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/53368445` |
   | `https://www.google.com/travel/flights/search?tfs=ABC&utm_source=x` | `https://www.google.com/travel/flights` | `https://www.google.com/travel/flights/search?tfs=ABC` |
   | `https://Example.com/Article/?utm_campaign=a&b=2&a=1#section` | none | `https://example.com/Article?a=1&b=2` |
   | `https://shop.example.com/item/9?ref=home` | `https://tracker.example.net/item/9` | `https://shop.example.com/item/9?ref=home` |

6. In `package.json` add `"test": "node --test test/"` to `scripts`.
7. Load it in the panel: in `shared/sidepanel.html` add `<script src="page-identity.js"></script>` immediately before `<script src="sidepanel.js"></script>` (line ~1726).
8. In `build.sh`, add `page-identity.js` to the `SHARED_FILES` list (line ~128) so the copied file is cleaned out of `exponential/` and `tradescape/` after the build. No esbuild step is needed.

## Files
- `shared/page-identity.js` — create: the three functions
- `test/page-identity.test.js` — create: table and edge cases
- `package.json` — modify: add the `test` script
- `shared/sidepanel.html` — modify: one script tag
- `build.sh` — modify: `SHARED_FILES`

## Dependencies
- Depends on: no other bead
- Server: Mirrors ticket `witty.otter`. If that ticket changes the rule or the table, change this file and its tests to match in the same sitting.
- Produces: `ExpoPageIdentity.pageIdentity` and `.savedAddress`, used by the save bead and the status-line bead.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. `npm test` passes and covers all four table rows
2. `savedAddress` on the first table row keeps `adults`, `check_in` and `check_out` in their original order and drops only `source_impression_id`
3. `pageIdentity` and `savedAddress` return `null` for `chrome://extensions`, `file:///x` and an unparseable string
4. A declared URL that differs from the visited one only by a leading `www.` or a trailing slash is accepted
5. Two visited URLs that differ only in parameter order produce the same identity
6. `dist/exponential-prod/page-identity.js` exists after `./build.sh --prod`, and `exponential/page-identity.js` does not
7. `./build.sh --prod` exits 0
close_reason: page-identity.js mirrors the server's identity.ts; 18 tests pass; prod build exits 0. Test script is 'node --test test/*.test.js' because 'node --test test/' fails on Node 24 (treats test/ as a module path).
